Senior DevOps Engineer - Azure. Job Description. Key Responsibilities. Work closely with Cloud Architects, Solution Architects, Developers, SRE, and Engineering teams to design and implement Azure infrastructure solutions for products and services. Design, deploy, and maintain Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, security, reliability, performance, and operational supportability. Create and maintain infrastructure architecture diagrams, technical documentation, deployment guides, and operational runbooks for Azure environments. Develop, automate, and test end-to-end cloud infrastructure provisioning and deployment using Infrastructure as Code and configuration-management tools. Implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, and Python, including automated provisioning, configuration, scaling, and operational tasks. Design and optimize Azure networking and cloud connectivity, including VNets, Subnets, NSGs, Route Tables, Load Balancers, Application Gateway, Private Endpoints, VPN, DNS, and Firewall. Deploy and manage Kubernetes/AKS and containerized workloads, including cluster configuration, application deployment, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting. Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated application and infrastructure deployments using Azure DevOps or equivalent tools. Develop and enhance infrastructure architecture, performance optimization, capacity planning, high availability, and disaster recovery solutions to support 99.9%+ uptime. Implement monitoring and observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, and Grafana to proactively identify infrastructure and application issues. Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to develop new technology initiatives focused on availability, scalability, security, performance, automation, and supportability. Troubleshoot complex Azure, Kubernetes, networking, Linux, Windows, and CI/CD issues and participate in root-cause analysis and production support. Establish and enforce cloud, DevOps, security, infrastructure, and automation best practices across environments. Stay current with emerging Azure, DevOps, Kubernetes, automation, security, and cloud-native technologies and continuously improve technical capabilities. Establish and maintain effective working relationships across Architecture, Engineering, Development, Security, QA, Operations, and Product teams. Prepare and deliver weekly technical updates and presentations on completed work, infrastructure improvements, automation initiatives, and technical solutions to senior team members and team leads. YOU MUST HAVE. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, testing, and supporting Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Strong hands-on experience with Azure services, networking, compute, storage, identity, security, and monitoring. Proficiency in Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, and Python for infrastructure automation and scripting. Strong understanding of Azure networking and cloud connectivity, including VNet, Subnets, NSGs, Routing, VPN, DNS, Load Balancer, Firewall, and Private Endpoints. Strong experience with Linux and Windows system administration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and best practices. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and preferably Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Strong experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps. Experience with Docker and containerized application deployments. Understanding of cloud security, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault, secrets management, and secure infrastructure practices. Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent monitoring/observability platforms. Product Security- Embedded / IoT. Job Description. Job Description: Product Security Engineer, Embedded / IoT . Experience: 2 to 10 years . Role Overview . We are looking for product security professionals with hands-on experience in assessing and securing embedded systems and IoT products. The role involves performing product security assessments, conducting VAPT, developing threat models and security requirements, reviewing security controls, and supporting SSDLC activities. The selected candidate will work closely with hardware, firmware, software, and product engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, recommend practical mitigations, and validate remediation. Key Skills . Understanding of embedded product architecture, microcontrollers, processors, bootloaders, memory, storage, and embedded Linux and/or RTOS environments. Ability to interpret hardware block diagrams, relevant schematic sections, and firmware architecture. Hands-on experience assessing debug, programming, or communication interfaces such as UART, JTAG/SWD, SPI, I\u00B2C, and USB. Familiarity with device debugging, flash access, firmware acquisition, and evaluation of debug and readout protections. Experience with firmware extraction or acquisition, unpacking, filesystem analysis, configuration review, and static and/or dynamic analysis.
